title: Bosehmon
description: A Cobblemon modpack featuring the classic optimization mods (for the bosehs).
body:
# Custom Cobblemon modpack.
Features optimization, quality of life, and the one and only Cobblemon modpack for fun with friends!

# Performance
Heavily based on the famous Fabulously Optimized modpack, Valhalla focuses on performance first. Using many well-established mods, you can expect much better performance than vanilla Minecraft.

# Tweaks
Through powerful quality of life mods, such as mousetweaks and AppleSkin, Minecraft keeps its identity while gaining capabilities vanilla players can only wish for.

# Future-proof
Running on 1.20.1 and fabric, Tcheam-mon is a modern modpack that is based on modern frameworks and recent minecraft versions.
